title: The Scoop - September 2026
summary: RT ProExec's The Scoop brings together the biggest professional and executive liability insurance stories over the past month.
body_markdown:
Read RT ProExec's collection of notable articles from across the industry.


- IN THE SPOTLIGHT:


Healthcare liability market conditions remain mixed, with several segments facing continued challenges.[Explore the trends affecting human services, senior care and medical spas.](https://blog.ryanspecialty.com/healthcare-liability-state-of-the-market-report)


- Travelers claim data shows that 60% of employment practices liability claims are brought by fired or laid-off employees,[and claims have become more frequent and more costly.](https://image.email.travelers.com/lib/fe5f15707c62007a7410/m/1/330104b1-5dee-4501-8a6a-83df82f028b4.pdf)


- Should cyber insurance cover alleged privacy violations? As wrongful data collection claims become more common,[some cyber insurers are introducing new exclusions to their policies.](https://blog.ryanspecialty.com/the-next-ai-liability-wave-patent-infringement-risk-is-accelerating)


- Many small and medium-sized businesses have adopted payment portals and other digital applications, but they often lack robust cyber security,[and that’s made them a target for cyber criminals.](https://www.claimsjournal.com/news/national/2026/08/31/339824.htm)


- Business dispute and antitrust claims are occurring more frequently, especially with private, service-based companies.[Marissa Streckfus joins the D&O Diary Podcast to discuss claims trends and D&O claims scenarios.](https://podcasts.apple.com/bm/podcast/costly-coverage-pitfalls-with-marissa-streckfus/id1896880954?i=1000780873203)


- AI can trigger patent infringement allegations in several distinct ways, and the sheer number of AI-related patents is increasing claims frequency.[This is a good time to reassess risk management.](https://www.advisen.com/tools/fpnproc/fpns/articles_new_1/P/553814467.html?rid=553814467&list_id=1%20)
- What do insurance professionals think of AI and related risks?[This episode of the D&O Diary Podcast looks at the governance risks behind AI, with insights from a recent survey.](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-governance-risk-behind-the-technology/id1896880954?i=1000787185496)


- For private capital firms, cybersecurity is becoming an essential part of transaction due diligence.[Here’s how M&A insurance can help manage cyber and technology risks.](https://www.beazley.com/en-001/news-and-events/from-acquisition-to-exit)


- How is mission creep shaping non-profit risk? When organizations offer more services,[they also take on more liability exposures, adding to the increasingly complex risk environment.](https://www.mynewmarkets.com/articles/184765/evolving-risk-landscape-for-nonprofits-reinforces-need-for-more-than-insurance-partner)


- Where does D&O coverage end and E&O coverage begin? It’s not always clear.[When D&O and E&O exposures overlap, the coverage structure is crucial for handling claims.](https://www.insurancejournal.com/magazines/mag-features/2026/07/27/878825.htm)
